name: George Johnson
title: Interview with George Johnson, Mound Bayou, Mississippi, September 1941

words.text: [long pause occurs before Dr. Johnson addresses Mr. Johnson with his first question]
[a woman inquires about Mr. Johnson and he answers]
[Mr. Johnson taps his cane to imitate Benjamin T. Montgomery, knocking on Jefferson Davis' door]
[Mrs. Elizabeth Lomax, encourages Dr. Johnson to ask Mr. Johnson if he can recall more songs]
[steam engine creeps forward tolling its bell]
[the train pushes through with a head of steam]
[Mr. George Johnson taps his cane for emphasis]
[Alan Lomax barely spoke in this interview]
[Mr. George Johnson raps his cane as he addresses questions]
[Mr. Johnson seems to rock in his chair],
